page_title: The open-source MCP and skills gateway for your whole company.

sources.entry: Metorial - Connect AI agents to 600+ integrations with a single interface - OAuth, scaling, and monitoring included

summary.name: Metorial
summary.one_liner: Metorial is an open-source MCP and skills gateway that lets a company connect AI clients like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor to approved tools behind SSO, with role-based access and per-call audit logs.
use_cases: Give a company's AI assistants governed access to internal and SaaS tools
Stop employees from pasting personal API keys into local MCP configs
Audit which person and which agent made each tool call
Share team workflows as reusable agent skills
Control which groups can use which tools via existing SSO
Self-host an MCP gateway on-prem or in a private cloud
summary.what_it_does: Metorial sits between AI clients and the tools they call, providing one MCP URL per person that works in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex or other MCP-compatible clients. Users sign in through the company identity provider (SAML SSO, with SCIM for account and group sync), and admins grant access to integrations, single tools or read-only sets by person or group. Each tool call is checked against policy, screened by Protoguard for prompt injection and provider schema changes, run on the user's own connected account, and recorded with their identity. The page also describes shared agent skills, where a workflow is written once and made available to teammates' agents, and the ability to connect internal or third-party remote MCP servers behind the same rules.
notable: Open core on GitHub, runnable self-hosted or on-prem
Per-person Magic MCP URL with SSO-based role access applied across all clients
Protoguard screens every call for prompt injection and schema changes
Shared agent skills combining instructions and tools
caveats: Enterprise pricing is custom and the Scale plan is fixed-price; current plan details are on the pricing page, not listed here
The page cites 1,100+ MCP servers and 21,000+ tools, while the awesome-ai-tools listing mentions 600+ integrations, so the figures differ by source
Access control and SSO features are described as part of the product; the page does not detail which plans include them
